== quote-all
'a b'	a b
'it''s $HOME'	it's $HOME
'say "hi"'	say "hi"
'`touch pwned`'	`touch pwned`
'$(touch pwned)'	$(touch pwned)
'x;touch pwned'	x;touch pwned
'star*'	star*
'~root'	~root
'o’’neil;touch pwned'	o’neil;touch pwned
'“q”'	“q”
back\slash	
a\:b	
C:\Users\me	a path: C:\Users\me
a!b	
'ends'''	ends'
'{a,b}'	{a,b}
'a&b|c<d>e'	a&b|c<d>e
'#hash'	#hash
true	
null	
'-foo.bar'	-foo.bar
@('--%')	--%
'–a.b'	–a.b
'-a:'	-a:
run 'a b': argv: [quote] [--odd] [a b]
run 'it''s $HOME': argv: [quote] [--odd] [it's $HOME]
run 'say "hi"': argv: [quote] [--odd] [say "hi"]
run '`touch pwned`': argv: [quote] [--odd] [`touch pwned`]
run '$(touch pwned)': argv: [quote] [--odd] [$(touch pwned)]
run 'x;touch pwned': argv: [quote] [--odd] [x;touch pwned]
run 'star*': argv: [quote] [--odd] [star*]
run '~root': argv: [quote] [--odd] [~root]
run 'o’’neil;touch pwned': argv: [quote] [--odd] [o’neil;touch pwned]
run '“q”': argv: [quote] [--odd] [“q”]
run back\slash: argv: [quote] [--odd] [back\slash]
run a\:b: argv: [quote] [--odd] [a\:b]
run C:\Users\me: argv: [quote] [--odd] [C:\Users\me]
run a!b: argv: [quote] [--odd] [a!b]
run 'ends''': argv: [quote] [--odd] [ends']
run '{a,b}': argv: [quote] [--odd] [{a,b}]
run 'a&b|c<d>e': argv: [quote] [--odd] [a&b|c<d>e]
run '#hash': argv: [quote] [--odd] [#hash]
run true: argv: [quote] [--odd] [true]
run null: argv: [quote] [--odd] [null]
run '-foo.bar': argv: [quote] [--odd] [-foo.bar]
run @('--%'): argv: [quote] [--odd] [--%]
run '–a.b': argv: [quote] [--odd] [–a.b]
run '-a:': argv: [quote] [--odd] [-a:]
== quote-shared
'x;touch pwned'	x;touch pwned
'x;touch pwnedz'	x;touch pwnedz
'x y'	x y
'x,y'	x,y
run 'x;touch pwned': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x;touch pwned]
run 'x;touch pwnedz': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x;touch pwnedz]
run 'x y': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x y]
run 'x,y': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x,y]
== quote-typed-quote
'it''s $HOME'	it's $HOME
run 'it''s $HOME': argv: [quote] [--odd] [it's $HOME]
== quote-typed-quote-shared
'x;touch pwned'	x;touch pwned
'x;touch pwnedz'	x;touch pwnedz
'x y'	x y
'x,y'	x,y
run 'x;touch pwned': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x;touch pwned]
run 'x;touch pwnedz': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x;touch pwnedz]
run 'x y': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x y]
run 'x,y': argv: [quote] [--pair] [x,y]

== quote-inline
